items.title: Chevron Earnings Skyrocket Amid Iran War Price Surge; Exxon On Tap

items.title: Chevron (CVX) Stock Looks Below Fair Value With Cash Flow But Above Fair Value On Earnings
items.summary: Chevron stock has more than doubled over the past five years, yet investors now face mixed signals on value as the intrinsic value estimate from a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) view suggests upside while earnings based multiples point to a richer price. Chevron has returned 133.2% over the past five years, which puts the current share price under closer scrutiny for anyone considering a new position or adding to an existing one. items.title: Oil industry sees war windfall but girds for political blowback
items.summary: US oil giants are set to report blowout profits Friday at a time when lofty gasoline prices are stressing consumers and exacerbating President Donald Trump's worries about upcoming midterm elections.Lowering gasoline prices before November is high on Trump's priority list, prompting numerous White House meetings, according to US media reports.
